description: One embedded file (a picture, a sound, a video, a font, an embedded document). This JSON is the node's payload; the file itself is the ONE other file of the node, the one with role `media`, byte-for-byte as it was embedded.

content_type.description: The media type the source declared for the file, e.g. `image/png`, `video/mp4`. May be empty or wrong; `encoding` is what the writer found in the bytes.

definition.description: Where a definition of `encoding` sufficient to build a decoder is: `base` = spec/MINI-SPECS.md (PNG, WAV); `formats` = the document MANIFEST.json `formats[encoding]` names, and the node's meta.file_formats.media equals `encoding`; `pending` = NOT in this package (the bytes are carried verbatim; the format is a public standard this profile's library does not define yet); `none` = there are no bytes.

embedded.description: true: the node has a file with role `media`. false: the document names this item but has no bytes for it (see `link`).

encoding.description: What the bytes are, as recognised from their first bytes by the writer: `png`, `wav`, a format id of MANIFEST.json `formats` when `definition` is `formats` (`jpeg`, `gif`, `bmp`, `tiff`, `webp`, `sfnt`, `emf-wmf`, `pdf`, `zip`, `isobmff`, `matroska`, `ogg`, `mp3`, `flac`, `aiff`, `aac`), or the name of an encoding this package does not define when `definition` is `pending` (any of the last seven of those, or `caf`, `asf`, `rf64`, `svg`, `unknown`); `none` when `embedded` is false.

id.description: The media id: what the rest of the document names this file by.

link.description: Where a linked (not embedded) item pointed when the document was made. It is a note about an origin: a reader NEVER follows it. null = the item was embedded.

name.description: The file's original name, e.g. `image1.png`. It is a label: nothing is looked up by it.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1.

title: core.media.asset
